statuses.label: Verified
statuses.description: Bit-exact or pixel-exact against the selected reference oracle; the checked-in gate passes.

statuses.label: Playable
statuses.description: Human-confirmed playable without a known blocking issue.

statuses.label: In-game
statuses.description: Reaches gameplay, but a crash, render, audio, input or save issue is documented.

statuses.label: Menus
statuses.description: Passes the title screen but does not reach main gameplay.

statuses.label: Boots
statuses.description: Reaches a boot/title sequence; no verified gameplay yet.

statuses.label: Runs (smoke)
statuses.description: Automated load-and-run smoke completed; no gameplay or visual verdict.

statuses.label: Nothing
statuses.description: Does not boot or shows no usable output.

statuses.label: Unsupported
statuses.description: The image format or required core path is not implemented yet.

systems.name: Nintendo Entertainment System / Famicom
systems.note: Headered and headerless No-Intro sets. Headered images run through unko-nes; headerless images need an iNES header and are marked Unsupported.

systems.name: Famicom Disk System
systems.note: FDS images run with a user-supplied disksys.rom. QD images are catalogued but not implemented yet.

systems.name: Super Nintendo / Super Famicom
systems.note: Automated 30-frame smoke for the full No-Intro set; the seven reference titles remain Verified against ares.
systems.test: cargo run --release -p unko-cli -- snes "game.sfc" --frames 600 --ipl ipl.rom --frame-out shot.ppm

systems.name: Nintendo 64
systems.note: Big-endian (.z64) and byte-swapped (.v64) dumps. Automated smoke only; real-cartridge accuracy remains gated by UNKO_N64_ROM.

systems.name: Nintendo 64DD
systems.note: Disk images are catalogued but not implemented; entries are marked Unsupported.
